name: gamecrab-theme
description: gameCrab — tema WordPress (Parcel + TailwindCSS + Swup + React)

scripts.dev: parcel watch src/main.js src/main.css src/admin.js src/admin.css --dist-dir dist --public-url ./ --no-hmr
scripts.build: rimraf dist .parcel-cache && parcel build src/main.js src/main.css src/admin.js src/admin.css --dist-dir dist --public-url ./ --no-source-maps
